entities.summary: Kongo Kingdom, a political institution in Angola during Kingdom of Kongo (1390–1483). Grew from Early Bantu Migration into Angola. Led to the emergence of Foundation and Expansion of Kongo and Portuguese Contact Kongo 1483.
